servicesIncluded.title: What's Included in Every Service

standard.headline: What's Included in a Standard Clean
standard.intro: A thorough, room-by-room clean that keeps your home fresh and healthy. Every visit follows the same checklist so you always know what to expect.
kitchen: Disinfect countertops and backsplash
Wash and polish the sink and faucet
Wipe the outside of the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, and microwave
Clean the stovetop surface and drip pans
Wipe cabinet fronts and handles, removing smudges and drips
Sweep and mop the floor
Take out the trash and replace the liner
bathrooms: Scrub and disinfect the toilet, top to bottom
Clean the sink, faucet, and vanity top
Scrub the tub, shower walls, and glass doors
Polish mirrors and glass until streak-free
Wipe towel bars, fixtures, and light switches
Sweep and mop the floor
Take out the trash
bedrooms: Dust furniture, shelves, and décor within reach
Dust ceiling fans and light fixtures within reach
Vacuum carpets and rugs
Sweep and mop hard floors
Make the beds (fresh linens if you leave them out for us)
Wipe windowsills
wholeHome: Wipe door handles, switches, and other high-touch spots
Spot-clean fingerprints on doors and walls

deep.headline: What's Included in a Deep Clean
deep.intro: Everything in our Standard Clean, plus the detailed work that builds up over time. Ideal for first-time visits, seasonal resets, or before and after hosting.
items: Wipe all baseboards, door frames, and doors, room by room
Clean inside windows, sills, and tracks if added
Wash light fixtures and fully clean ceiling fans
Scrub grout and tile in bathrooms
Remove soap scum and mineral buildup from fixtures and glass
Degrease the stovetop, range hood exterior, and backsplash
Wipe vents, registers, and exhaust fan covers
Clean behind and under furniture where it can be moved safely
Remove cobwebs from all corners and ceilings
Wash walls where marks and scuffs are visible

move_in_out.headline: What's Included in a Move-In / Move-Out Clean
move_in_out.intro: A top-to-bottom clean of an empty home, built to help you get your deposit back or start fresh in your new place. For best results, the home should be empty and the utilities on.
kitchen: Clean inside and outside the oven, including racks and door glass if added
Clean inside and outside the microwave
Clean inside the refrigerator and freezer, including shelves and drawers if added
Degrease the stovetop, burners, and drip pans
Wipe inside and outside all cabinets and drawers
Disinfect countertops and backsplash
Scrub the sink and faucet, removing buildup
Wipe appliance exteriors, switches, and fixtures
Sweep and mop the floor, including corners and edges
bathrooms: Scrub and disinfect the toilet, including the base and behind it
Scrub tile, grout, tub, and shower walls
Clean shower glass and tracks
Remove buildup from faucets and showerheads
Clean the sink, vanity, and countertop
Clean inside the medicine cabinet and drawers
Polish mirrors
Wipe baseboards, door frames, and the exhaust fan cover
Mop the floor and scrub grout lines
bedrooms: Wipe shelves, built-ins, and closet interiors, including rods and floors
Clean windowsills, tracks, and frames if added
Clean mirrors and glass
Wipe baseboards and door frames
Spot-clean walls
Dust light fixtures and ceiling fans
Vacuum carpets or mop hard floors
throughout: Clean inside windows, sills, and tracks if added
Wash light fixtures and ceiling fans
Vacuum all carpet, including closets, and mop hard floors
Empty and wipe down all trash cans

str_turnover.headline: Short-Term Rental Turnover
str_turnover.intro: A fast, consistent reset between guests so every arrival looks like your listing photos.
bedrooms: Strip beds and bag used linens
Remake beds with fresh linens, hotel-style
Wipe nightstands, dressers, and lamps
Dust fans and light fixtures
Check under beds and in drawers for left-behind items
Vacuum or mop floors
Restyle pillows and throws to match your listing
bathrooms: Scrub and disinfect toilet, shower, tub, and sink
Polish mirrors
Set out fresh towels
Restock toilet paper, soap, and amenities you provide
Mop floors and empty trash
Report any damage or maintenance issues
kitchen: Wash, dry, and put away guest dishes
Disinfect counters and appliance exteriors
Clean inside the microwave
Check the refrigerator and clear any guest leftovers
Restock the supplies you provide (dish soap, sponge, paper towels)
Sweep, mop, and take out the trash
living: Clean the TV screen and glass
